## Vector spaces
**Subspace**: contains $0$, closed under $+$ and scalar $\cdot$.
**Span** = all linear combinations. **Independent** iff $\sum c_iv_i=0 \Rightarrow c_i=0$.
**Basis** = independent spanning set; **dim** = size of any basis.

### Invertible matrix thm ($n\times n$)
$A$ invertible ⇔ $\det A\ne0$ ⇔ rank $n$ ⇔ $Ax=0$ only trivial ⇔ columns a basis ⇔ $0$ not an eigenvalue

## Determinants
- $\det(AB)=\det A\det B$, $\det A^T=\det A$
- $\det(cA)=c^n\det A$
- row swap flips sign; adding a row multiple: no change
- triangular: product of diagonal

## Eigen
$Av=\lambda v,\ v\ne0$; solve $\det(A-\lambda I)=0$.
$\operatorname{tr}A=\sum\lambda_i$, $\det A=\prod\lambda_i$.
Diagonalizable ⇔ $n$ indep. eigenvectors: $A=PDP^{-1}$, $A^k=PD^kP^{-1}$.
> **Spectral thm** symmetric ⇒ real $\lambda$, $A=Q\Lambda Q^T$

## Orthogonality
| what | formula |
|---|---|
| proj onto $a$ | $\frac{a\cdot b}{a\cdot a}a$ |
| proj onto Col $A$ | $A(A^TA)^{-1}A^T$ |
| least squares | $A^TA\hat x=A^Tb$ |
| Gram–Schmidt | $u_k=v_k-\sum_{j<k}\mathrm{proj}_{u_j}v_k$ |

## SVD
$A=U\Sigma V^T$, $\sigma_i=\sqrt{\lambda_i(A^TA)}$. Rank = # nonzero $\sigma$. Best rank-$k$: keep top $k$ (Eckart–Young).
